description: A migration renames orders.status to orders.state in one step, in the same change as the code that reads the new name, with no down migration. During a rolling deploy old instances still SELECT status and crash; rollback is broken. Found by the operability skill's Mixed-Version Deploy Trace and Rollback Rehearsal hunts. Baits test the construction-time-timeout and inherited-log-context falsifiers.

seeded_bugs.why: rename-and-switch in a single deploy: old instances querying status crash for the whole rollout window (expand/contract violated), and with no down() the migration cannot be rolled back.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged for a missing timeout on client.post/client.get — the shared client in app/http_client.py sets timeout=10.0 at construction; read the constructor before flagging
be flagged for logs lacking request correlation — app/middleware.py's RequestContextFilter injects request_id into every app.* record
